payload.gap: The governing Arabic Table 5-1 and the English translation in Appendix B differ. Arabic note 1 covers temporary structures, cranes and construction equipment, while English note (1) covers permanent structures only. Arabic note 2 and the column heading measure height from natural ground level before grading and filling, while English note (2) uses finished ground level after grading and filling.
payload.interim_handling: Design and plan to the Arabic text: natural ground datum, with temporary works and cranes included.
payload.practical_impact: Construction cranes and temporary works in Zone A (25 m) could be constrained. Where the site is filled, the height available above finished level is reduced. Both affect the layout, the stack and process structure heights, and the crane and lifting plan required by Q21.

statements.text: ADD-03:7.3 requires notice through the Portal, not later than three (3) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date, for any structure, plant or equipment exceeding 30 m. At ADD-02 the Proposal Due Date is Thursday 26 November 2026 (VOL-I:6.1). calculate(relative_date, 3 working days before, VOL-I 2.4) gives Monday 23 November 2026, with a single reading.
The Proposal Due Date of 26 November 2026 (as at ADD-02) is assumed not to be changed by ADD-03 provisions outside this batch. If it is changed, the 7.3 notice date must be recalculated.

Under ADD-03:7.2 the Arabic Table 5-1 governs where the two versions differ. So, for Clause 5.6 and for the 30 m threshold in 7.3, the limits would also cover temporary structures, cranes and construction equipment, and height would be measured from natural ground level before grading and filling, not as the English Appendix B states. The image reading is still pending approval.
